description:
Is I-5 open right now: lane closures, chain controls, road weather and sign messages on the freeway in California, and the nearest dog stop to each?
Live state, not rules: Caltrans feeds fetched within the last 15 minutes (fetched_at in the result), not verified rules. Covers the Grapevine and every other stretch of I-5 in California. Other highways are not covered.
Inputs: from_mile and to_mile, or near={lat, lon} with direction and ahead_miles; with none, all of I-5 in California.
Each condition is placed on the I-5 centerline (mile, s meters from San Ysidro) and matched to the nearest dog stop. If the feeds cannot be read the answer has outcome unavailable and the address of the live Caltrans page. A result older than two hours is marked stale.

Examples:
  - "Is there a closure or chains on the Grapevine right now?" -> from_mile=170, to_mile=222
  - "Weather and closures in the next 60 miles northbound from Redding" -> near={lat:40.59, lon:-122.39}, direction="north", ahead_miles=60

near.description: A point on or near I-5

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: dogpolicies_i5_conditions

accepted.description: With bad_input: each argument that could not be read, with the values it accepts

code.description: With an outcome other than ok: not_found, invalid, unavailable

did_you_mean.description: Close matches to what was asked for: towns, places, slugs or brands, best first

fetched_at.description: When the loop fetched the feeds; null when no document could be read

nearest.description: When nothing is inside the radius: the nearest places in the data, with distance_miles

nearest_i5.description: With a point too far from I-5: the nearest point on I-5 and how far it is

next.description: Calls that would answer the question, in words

outcome.description: Absent or ok: a normal answer. no_match: nothing in the data matches, see did_you_mean, nearest and next. bad_input: the arguments cannot be used as given, see next. partial: some of the ids were found, see missing. unavailable: a live source could not be read. None of these is an error.

resolved_from.description: Set when a word was read as the value the tool uses: hotel as lodging, NB as north. Each key is the argument; asked is what was sent, used what it was read as

stale.description: True when the document is older than two hours

title: I-5 conditions now
